scope: Disposable Kind v1.36.1 cluster. Creates an owned namespace, one digest-pinned synthetic mock workload, a default-deny NetworkPolicy, and a named-object read-only Role. Captures API-visible posture, detects controlled changes to Pod Security Admission labels, NetworkPolicy rules and Role verbs, reapplies the desired manifests, and verifies recovery from live API reads. Joins an offline fictional advisory fixture to a synthetic component observation. This does not run a CIS Kubernetes Benchmark scanner, validate NetworkPolicy packet enforcement, inspect real image contents, consume advisory feeds, establish source authenticity or freshness, assess managed-service settings, or cover GPU/CUDA advisories, webhook/OPA/Kyverno change monitoring, cluster-wide RBAC, vulnerability scanning, or production alert delivery.

Offline fictional component metadata joins exactly and the version near miss stays unmatched
Posture assessment detects each controlled owned-resource regression
